---
title: "Checking in a dog"
---

When a dog arrives, find it on the dog list and open its card. The card tells
you whether the dog is cleared to groom today.

## Before you start

- You've [picked your name](signing-in.qmd).

## Steps

1. Search for the dog by its name or the owner's name.

   ![The dog list](/screenshots/groomer/dog-list.png)

2. Open the dog's card and check the vaccine line at the top.

   ![A dog's card](/screenshots/groomer/dog-card.png)

3. *(Steps to come.)*

::: {.callout-warning}
## If the card says the dog can't be groomed
Rabies that has run out stops the groom. Ask the owner for current paperwork;
the system won't let the groom start until it's on file.
:::
